title: HeadGuard: Selective Head Protection for Low-Bit VLM KV-Cache Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2609.35800v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-bit key-value (KV) cache quantization saves storage but can sharply degrade vision-language model (VLM) accuracy. We introduce HeadGuard, a composable head-protection method that augments a base KV-cache quantizer with a fixed high-precision mask. Image-sensitivity and output-sensitivity scores select physical KV heads offline, with approximately 1/8 protected in the main experiments; their image keys and optionally values remain in bfloat16 (BF16), while the base quantizes unprotected image entries. Across eight VLMs, three base quantizers, and eight benchmarks (six discriminative and two generative), HeadGuard recovers a substantial fraction of lost accuracy on weaker quantizers, with the strongest gains for Qwen and InternVL. At 2 bits, the six-task discriminative mean over eight models rises from 0.436 to 0.580 on the weakest base; protection can also improve generated answers and caption fidelity to BF16 outputs. translated_title: HeadGuard：面向低比特视觉语言模型KV缓存量化的选择性注意力头保护方法
translated_abstract: 低比特键值（KV）缓存量化虽然能节省存储空间，但会显著降低视觉语言模型（VLM）的准确率。我们提出了HeadGuard，一种可组合的注意力头保护方法，它通过固定的高精度掩码来增强基础KV缓存量化器。该方法利用图像敏感度和输出敏感度评分在离线阶段选择物理KV头，主实验中约保护八分之一的头；这些受保护头的图像键（以及可选的值）保持为bfloat16（BF16）高精度格式，而基础量化器仅对未受保护的图像条目进行量化。在八个视觉语言模型、三种基础量化器和八个基准测试（六个判别式任务和两个生成式任务）上的实验表明，HeadGuard在较弱的量化器上恢复了相当大比例的精度损失，其中Qwen和InternVL模型获益最大。在2比特设置下，八个模型在六个判别式任务上的平均精度在最弱的基础量化器上从0.436提升至0.580；头保护机制还能改善生成答案的质量，并使图像描述的保真度更接近BF16输出。
tldr: HeadGuard通过图像敏感度和输出敏感度评分离线选择约八分之一的KV头保持BF16高精度，显著恢复了低比特KV缓存量化下视觉语言模型的精度损失，在2比特设置下将八个模型的六任务判别式平均精度从0.436提升至0.580。
